items.title: Costco's October Net Sales Jump 12.6% as Digital Growth Accelerates
items.summary: Costco's October sales surge 12.6%, fueled by strong comparable sales and digital growth, but its premium valuation and earnings revisions raise concerns.

items.title: Rate Hikes Could Be Coming: History Likes These 4 Consumer Staples Stocks
items.summary: The Fed ended its pause, and traders now price in another hike by December. Three past tightening cycles reveal which household-name staples stocks protected portfolios, and one of them beat the market every single time.

items.title: Costco Stock: Earnings Growth Could Shape the Next Big Move
items.summary: Six straight earnings beats have pushed Costco shares up 20% this year, yet a 49x trailing P/E leaves little room for error. One metric could decide whether the rally keeps running or finally stalls.

items.title: iShares U.S. Consumer Discretionary (IYC) Adds Amazon and Tesla on Nov. 4
items.summary: The fund bought $244.2 million of stock, adding to 153 positions and trimming none, with $33.6 million going into Amazon.

items.title: ‘Only Go Into Physical Stores Every Sixth Week’: Clark Howard’s Anti-Impulse Rule as Costco Hits $1,025
items.summary: Clark Howard spent years watching couples bleed money one warehouse trip at a time, and the fix he landed on sounds almost too simple to work. With Costco shares surging past $1,000 and the holiday treasure-hunt season starting, the math behind his rule gets uncomfortable fast.

items.title: In 1975, Sol Price Was Pushed Out of FedMart, the Discount Chain He Founded. The Warehouse Store He Opened Next Became Part of Costco
items.summary: A lawyer-turned-retailer got fired from the discount chain he built over two decades, and the warehouse he opened next with a handful of friends and a converted Hughes property became the blueprint for one of the most powerful retail businesses on the planet.

items.title: BARK Inc (BARK) (Q2 2027) Earnings Call Highlights: Revenue Beat, Lixsters Launch and Strategic ...
items.summary: BARK Inc (BARK) topped Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue guidance with $87.6 million, returned to positive adjusted EBITDA, and unveiled new growth initiatives while exiting Bark Air.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 5: Amazon Shares Slide as Technology Selloff Erases Early Gains
items.summary: On Nov. 5, 2026, Amazon shares reversed an early rally as rising yields and tech selling took over the session.
